proof_body:
by
  intro R _ I J h a b
  have h1 : (1 : R) ∈ I ⊔ J := by
    rw [h]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hij⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp h1
  refine ⟨a * j + b * i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : a * j + b * i - a = (b - a) * i := by
      linear_combination a * hij
    rw [this]
    exact I.mul_mem_left _ hi
  · have : a * j + b * i - b = (a - b) * j := by
      linear_combination b * hij
    rw [this]
    exact J.mul_mem_left _ hj
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I J : Ideal R), I ⊔ J = ⊤ → ∀ a b : R, ∃ x : R, x - a ∈ I ∧ x - b ∈ J
